name: Bajaj Electricals Ltd
title: Bajaj Electricals Ltd-$ - 500031 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome

read.thesis: Consumer Products loss on operating deleverage and channel still elevated in coolers; Lighting record 8.5% EBIT margin, capex to fall below half of past levels, but no numeric FY27 guidance.

capex.quote: Next capex will substantially come down. It will be less than half what we have been doing in the past.

triggers.label: Capex to fall below half of past
triggers.quote: Next capex will substantially come down. It will be less than half what we have been doing in the past.

triggers.label: Channel stock mostly corrected; coolers lag
triggers.quote: Now most of that is out. The stock levels are now reasonable.

triggers.label: Price hikes 3-10% in Q4 and April
triggers.quote: our price increases have ranged from anywhere from 3% to 10% in quarter 4, and we have already taken a price increase in the same range in April.

triggers.label: Consumer Products loss in Q4
triggers.quote: For the quarter, the vertical reported a loss due to operating deleverage.

triggers.label: Consumer margin recovery to FY24/25 uncertain
triggers.quote: it's difficult at this stage to say whether we'll be able to deliver '24/'25 margin.

guidance.quote: Our intent is to make industry average, at least industry average profit and industry average is between 6 to 8%, 9%

guidance.value: Grow ahead of market (market mid-single digit)
guidance.quote: our growth rate should be more than that
the expectation is to continue on those same lines for the next year as well
recommended a final dividend of INR 3 a share

red_flags.label: Fans losing share on BLDC gap
red_flags.quote: we have lost a bit of market share

evasions.quote: we'll not be able to tell you the figures where we want to reach from here
